description: Plan a meal for a specific date and meal type. Provide recipeId to link an existing recipe (from list_recipes) OR name for a custom meal; when recipeId is given any name is ignored and stored as null.

date.description: Date, YYYY-MM-DD. Must be today or within the next 28 days, so work it out from today's date.

name.description: Custom meal name when no recipe is linked.

recipeId.description: Recipe id from list_recipes or list_global_recipes.

recipeSource.description: Use 'global' when recipeId came from list_global_recipes. Defaults to 'household'.

name: create_meal_plan
